Horsens is a Danish municipality evaluated in the 2022–2023 Annual Report of the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) [^src1]. The report assesses clinical quality in the treatment of atrial fibrillation, specifically tracking Indicator 5, which measures the prevention of ischemic stroke via anticoagulant treatment using data from the DanStroke registry and the National Patient Register (LPR) [^src1]. 

In the report's detailed municipal breakdown, Horsens is listed with specific performance metrics regarding stroke events among atrial fibrillation patients [^src1]. The data records 10 stroke events out of a denominator of 1,988 patients, yielding a relative rate of 0.5 (with a confidence interval of 0.2–0.9), alongside a secondary metric showing 11 events out of 1,938 patients with a rate of 0.6 [^src1]. As one of the 98 municipalities analyzed, Horsens's inclusion supports the report's role as a tool for local quality development and benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system [^src1].
